forms:
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,14)><$kfacial(4)><$comeff(4,9)>I feel like there’s even more <$cdef(27)>humidity than before... It’s
really making me want to...to...
<$textsize(2)>*YAAAAAAWWWWWWN*</textsize>

<$facial(4,1)><$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,5)>Th-that yawn just now... It was perfect! A <$cdef(27)>full
100-point yawn!
<$emotion(2,1)><$voicel(2,10)>Yaaay! It’s raining!
<$emotion(3,8)><$voicel(3,10)>Oooh, that feels so nice! ♪
<$emotion(5,2)><$voicel(5,10)>Whoa, awesome! It actually worked!

<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,659)>Hohoho! See, it’s just as I told you.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,661)>Now it should be easier to break the walls trapping <$cdef(27)>Onix in
that ca—
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm?
<$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,6)>Uh...who turned off the rain?
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Oh dear... I really doubt that was enough rain to help...
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,6)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke</color>, can you yawn again?
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,14)>Sure, of course...<wait(1.3)><$motion(4,806)><$facial(4,14)><$se2d(979)> *yawn*
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)>...<$cdef(27)>2 points</color>.
<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,39)>The rain made me so happy that it kinda woke me right up!
<$voicel(3,3)><$motion(3,807)><$facial(3,9)><$comeff(3,10)>Awww... But we all worked so hard!
<$textsize(2)>Gyararoooah!</textsize>

<$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,4)>Wh-what was that?!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>It sounded like it was coming from the ocean! Let’s all
go see!
<$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,10)>Whoa... They’re huge...
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,14)>C-could that be—?

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$cdef(27)>, I’m sure you could whip up
something
to
walk
on
to
reach
that
Pokémon, right?
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>Could you go and talk to that Pokémon on our behalf?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>Could you please go talk to that huge
Pokémon, <$cdef(27)>?
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,803)><$comeff(4,6)>I wonder what you need to eat to get THAT big...
<$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,8)>I feel like it’s about to rain again!
<$voicel(3,8)><$motion(3,803)><$facial(3,4)><$comeff(3,10)>Wow, that’s a really BIG, really LOUD Pokémon!
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,1)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>That Pokémon’s so cool! <wait(0.5)>And HUGE!
<$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,6)>Well, ain’t you an odd one. You a human? Or a Pokémon?

<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,10)>Gwahaha! Course you are! And you got real guts comin’
this close to me too!
<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,10)>Gwahaha! Ya got real guts tellin’ me such an obvious lie!

<$voicel(5,6)>Anyway, ya need me fer somethin’?
<$voicel(5,1)><$motion(5,803)>...What’s that, now? Ya say it won’t rain?

<$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,14)>Oh, hmmm...
<$voicel(5,5)>The humans were makin’ a real fuss, y’see. So, I headed
down to the <$voicel(5,4)><$motion(5,807)>quiet ocean floor fer a good, long nap...
<$voicel(5,5)><$emotion(5,14)>But I s’pose that made it stop rainin’ here, huh? <$voicel(5,2)><$motion(5,802)><$facial(5,9)><$comeff(5,7)>Sure am
sorry ’bout that.

<$voicel(5,3)>Wait a minute...
<$voicel(5,7)><$comeff(5,3)>I only woke up ’cause I felt rain splashin’ on the surface of
the water...
<$voicel(5,6)><$motion(5,803)><$comeff(5,6)>Did y’all do somethin’ to make it rain?

<$voicel(5,5)><$comeff(5,14)><$motion(5,666)>Hmmm. I see. Didn’t know there were others out there who
could call the rain like me...
<$voicel(5,7)><$comeff(5,10)><$facial(5,4)>Gwahaha! Y’all sure are an interestin’ bunch!
<$voicel(5,9)><$motion(5,801)><$comeff(5,9)>That settles it—startin’ today, y’all can consider me
yer friend!

<$cdef(27)>Kyogre, the Sea Basin Pokémon, has been registered in
your Pokédex...
Your Trainer rank increased to <$cdef(27)><$dtrnrank;0(2)>!

<$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$facial(5,4)><$comeff(5,3)>All right now! How ’bout I get a li’l rain fallin’ fer my new
friends? Lessee here...
<$motionoff(5,804)><$facial(5,7)><$comeff(5,10)><$se2d(969)><$padvib(3)><$textsize(2)>Gyararoooah!

<$voicel(5,7)><$motion(5,806)>Phew... I think I’m gonna go take another nap. <$voicel(5,10)><$emotion(5,39)>Sure hope
I can see ya again sometime, <$cdef(27)>!
<$voicel(2,9)><$emotion(2,8)>Yaaay! So much rain! It’s pouring!

<$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>All right, <$cdef(27)>. Seeing that rain
cleared
up
any doubt!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)>I’m sure that was the Legendary Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Kyogre—right?
<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Bringing rain to this parched land of ours would be a
simple task for the likes of <$cdef(27)>Kyogre!
<$voicel(3,8)><$emotion(3,39)>Really?! That’s AMAZING!
<$voicel(2,5)><$motion(2,805)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)>Wait, hold on... Does that mean my <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance</color> party...
<$comcan(2)><$voicel(5,5)><$motion(5,805)><$comeff(5,14)>And my epic yawn...
<$comcan(5)><$voicel(4,3)><$motion(4,807)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,6)>All our hard work...meant nothing?

<$voicel(1,6)>Hmmm... <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)>Oh!!!
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,10)>Yes! Of course! That small amount of rain we got earlier
was what woke <$cdef(27)>Kyogre up!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,39)>All your hard work definitely wasn’t for nothing!

<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,806)><$comeff(4,14)>Think you could bust up that wall there in front of ya and
<$voicel(4,7)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>make a hole big enough for me to get out?

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,1)>Thank <$cdef(27)>Tangrowth for me, will ya?! I couldn’t have gotten
out without their smarts!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,6)>So, <$cdef(27)>, were you able to
rescue <$cdef(27)>Onix?

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>Hohoho! That’s good to hear! <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)>This is all thanks to you and
the others working so hard together!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,803)>Oh...and the rain just stopped.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,14)>Thanks to you, Pokémon have been reappearing one
after another.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>And we’ve even gotten to see the Legendary
Pokémon <$cdef(27)>Kyogre!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>I believe the rain will continue falling in this town as it
used to, providing the land with moisture.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>And looking at you now, I daresay you may be able to
pass through that gate you discovered before.
<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>If you go through that gate, I most definitely plan to
accompany you!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Why, we might meet some more new Pokémon there—or
even humans!

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,14)>Hey, heyyy! Looks like we’re gettin’ some crazy rain here
now! <$voicel(4,5)><$motion(4,805)><$comeff(4,6)>That your handiwork, <$cdef(27)>?

<$voicel(4,9)><$emotion(4,8)>Heck yeah! Thanks! I can tell the walls and floor of the
cave are way softer now!

<$voicel(4,1)><$motion(4,802)><$facial(4,9)><$comeff(4,7)>But, uh...I hate to admit it, but I’ve been stuck here so
long that I’ve got barely any strength left to break out!
<$voicel(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,10)>Ohhh yeah! Now I can finally get outta here!

<$motion(4,803)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,21)><$voicel(4,7)><$cdef(27)>! It’s all thanks to you, bud! I’ll
never
forget
what
you’ve
done
for
me here!

<$voicel(4,9)><$comeff(4,1)>Thank <$cdef(27)>Tangrowth for me, will ya?! I couldn’t have gotten
out without their smarts!
<$voicel(4,8)><$motion(4,801)><$facial(4,4)><$comeff(4,9)>Yeah! That’s what I thought!
<$voicel(3,5)><$motion(3,803)><$comeff(3,6)>Actually... Did YOU do any work at all?
<$voicel(4,6)><$motionoff(4,804)><$facial(4,7)><$comeff(4,10)>Uh, yeah! I worked up a sweat cheering all of you on!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,8)>Hohoho! Well, all’s well that ends well.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$comeff(1,6)>More importantly—<$cdef(27)>! Do you
think
you
can
rescue
<$cdef(27)>Onix now?
<$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$facial(1,4)>Go check out that cave before this rain stops falling!

<$comeff(4,10)><$voicel(4,5)><$cdef(27)>! Help me out, bud! Bust up that
wall
there
in
front
of ya!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Of course, I do still recommend you continue making this
town more comfortable.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>You do what feels best to you! I look forward to seeing
what you get up to next.

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)><$comeff(1,14)>As you are now, I believe you’re ready to move past
this town to new and distant places...
<$voicel(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,9)>And I’ll be going with you!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>We might meet more new Pokémon there—or
even humans!

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)>Of course, I do still recommend you continue making this
town more comfortable.
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,39)>You do what feels best to you! I look forward to seeing
what you get up to next.
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)>Hoho!

<$voicel(2,5)>Now that I have a home near the water, <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,39)>I feel like I’m just
full of energy!
<$voicel(2,7)><$motion(2,805)>I bet I could even <$voicel(2,10)><$comeff(2,10)>help make it rain now!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,8)>It looks like you found that <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1263)>!
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,827)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)>Do you think you’re about ready for the <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance party?

<$voicel(1,3)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,654)>I see. So, now you need a <$cdef(27)>plate...
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>I imagine there must be one kicking around
here somewhere...
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>Or you might be able to buy one via the <$cdef(27)>PC! Why don’t
you check and see?
<$voicel(4,4)><$motion(4,805)>Y’know... I’m getting a little sleepy... <wait(0.5)><wait(0.5)><$se2d(981)><$motion(4,806)>*yawwwn*

<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,9)>Oh! I’d give that yawn just now a score of <$cdef(27)> points! We
need just one last push to reach <$cdef(27)>100!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho... It seems <$cdef(27)>Squirtle</color>’s <$cdef(27)>Rain Dance </color>party went well.

<$voicel(1,9)><$motion(1,664)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>I can feel that extra moisture in the air! You should go
see how <$cdef(27)>Slowpoke’s yawn is coming along!

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,49)>Hey now, look who’s already got <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2533)>!
<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,805)>Do you, uh, think I could have ’em?

<$voicel(4,7)><$emotion(4,39)>Aw yeah, check out those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(2533)>—they’re pretty
as heck! Just lookin’ at them chills me out.
Thanks a bunch, <$cdef(27)>!
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Y’know, I don’t share my flower-lovin’ side with most folks,<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>
but I’m glad I shared it with you!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>So those seeds will grow into <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)> just like the ones
you’ve got, huh?
<$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,7)>Interesting... Any chance you’re willing to part with
those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(14)> ?
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,1)>Thanks, <$cdef(27)><pname;0></color>!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>Bet this’ll taste real nice right after a workout...
